name: York Dark Chocolate Peppermint Pattie
whyItWorks: Combines a thin layer of dark chocolate with a soft, cool peppermint sugar fondant. Contains only 2.5g of fat per full-sized patty (far lower than nutty candy bars), while real peppermint oil exerts a gentle antispasmodic effect.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy cool or room temperature. A refreshing, low-fat chocolate treat.
